articles.title: US arms firm Anduril could make interceptors in Europe, executive says
articles.summary: U.S. defense firm Anduril could eventually manufacture its newly unveiled Steelfin interceptor missiles in Europe, a company executive said.

articles.title: Six Soldier-athletes to represent Army WCAP at United World Wrestling Championships in Kazakhstan
articles.summary: Six Soldier-athletes from the U.S. Army World Class Athlete Program will carry Army pride and medal ambitions on to wrestling’s biggest international stage.
